What has gone unused, over a window it states, with why each row might still matter.

Capabilities that are installed and unused. Nothing is removed automatically and nothing is called rubbish — a server nobody has called might be worthless, or might be the one that matters twice a year.

Under the router an unused server costs a few kilobytes of cached schema and nothing else — no process, no memory, no start-up. The reason to remove one is that its tools are cluttering the model's list, or that you no longer trust it. Both are your call, and neither is disk space.
